findings.title: Pre-commit sidecar tests require an unprovisioned venv
findings.description: This hook unconditionally invokes pytest from the repository-local .sidecar-venv, but a fresh checkout does not create that environment and the documented setup in build-sidecar.sh only installs requirements.txt, which does not include pytest. Contributors using the hook therefore cannot commit until they discover and manually provision a separate test environment.

findings.title: WAV serialization blocks the sidecar event loop
findings.description: _run_generation is an async task, but this synchronous write serializes the entire generated audio array on the FastAPI event-loop thread. For long recordings the disk write can stall status polling, health checks, and unrelated requests until serialization finishes; run the write in a worker thread or use an async file path.

findings.title: Voice conversion pushes the sidecar server past 1,000 lines
findings.description: This change grows server.py from 685 to 1,087 lines, crossing the review's 1,000-line file-size threshold. The new route owns a nested conversion workflow spanning model loading, reference preparation, chunking, and output assembly. Move that workflow into a focused voice-conversion module and leave the route to validate the request and enqueue the work; this brings the server back below the threshold and keeps endpoint wiring separate from inference logic.

findings.title: Keep voice conversion out of the oversized HTTP server module
findings.description: This change takes server.py from 685 to 1087 lines and adds the voice conversion model lifecycle and inference as a nested endpoint implementation. The HTTP module now owns routing, generation state, profile sample preparation, model loading, chunking, and audio conversion, so changes to the conversion engine are coupled to the API layer and harder to isolate. Move the conversion lifecycle into a focused sidecar module and leave the route to validate the request and enqueue that operation.

findings.title: Voice conversion has no successful-path test
findings.description: The new voice-conversion endpoint is tested only with requests that return 400. Nothing exercises a valid profile and source file through job queuing, model conversion, generation status, or audio retrieval, so regressions that make the advertised conversion mode fail after validation remain undetected. Add a model-free endpoint test with mocked conversion dependencies that verifies a valid request completes and returns usable audio, including the long-recording path if practical.

findings.title: Timed TTS route branch is not tested
findings.description: The new timestamp-synchronized behavior is exercised only through the standalone audio assembly helper. The `/generate` integration tests cover rejected inputs and unknown IDs, while the binary test submits legacy text without `segments` or `original_duration`; no test sends the Rust-shaped timed payload through the route. A regression in segment filtering, per-segment synthesis, word-gap padding, or duration assembly could therefore pass the suite. Add an integration test with model calls stubbed that submits timestamped segments and checks the completed WAV is positioned and padded to the requested duration.

findings.title: Nested segment removal can leave later phrases overlapping
findings.description: When the fallback receives overlapping intervals such as A=[0,5], nested B=[1,2], and C=[3,6], B is clamped to start at 5 but later removed as degenerate. C is compared against B's end (2), so it remains at 3 and overlaps A; timed assembly then truncates A at C's start, cutting off generated speech. This path is used when Whisper provides segment timestamps but no word timestamps.
